stories.title: Let a person leave the user entry without choosing a user
stories.what: The entry where a person says which user account's own policy is wanted, built so that pressing Escape closes it with no user chosen. Turning a typed name into a security identifier (the account's unique number) and refusing an invalid one is done by the account lookup, built in its own story, which this entry hands the typed text to.
stories.why: A person who opens the entry to name a user can back out with Escape and carry on without having chosen a user.

criteria.says: Given the person is naming a user, when they press Escape, then the entry closes with no user chosen.

open: Should the entry show the translated security identifier to the person before they confirm, as the old dialog did?
Should leaving be possible by other means than Escape, such as a Cancel button?
